summary: Iteration 4 Domain Analysis rewrite (Serper-verified, no hallucination, Claude added to engines_checked, strict topic-tied verified rankings) verified end-to-end. 21/22 backend tests pass (1 transient network flake in a parallel worker retried green). New TestDomainAsyncJob class (5 tests, ~75s) exercises: async POST returns {id,status:'processing'} in <3s; stripe.com returns >=5 verified citation_sources (real domains like reddit/apple/wikipedia surface with position/query/url/title/snippet), >=3 verified ranking_prompts each with numeric google_rank (1-10) and url ON stripe.com and topic tied to top_topics; citetail.com strict returns just 2 citations and 0 rankings — every citation contains the brand literal (no fabricated wikipedia entries); notion.so citation domains are all well-formed registrable and none equal to notion.so. engines_checked==['Google','ChatGPT','Claude','Perplexity','Gemini'] on every report. UI verified via past-report cards: engines-checked chips include Claude, Verified Citations/Rankings metric cards present, NO legacy Domain Authority/Backlinks/Traffic, top-topics chips render, citation-sources shows 5 rows with toggle-citations 'View 16 more' expanding to 21 and collapsing back to 5, ranking-prompts shows either 'Google #<n>' badges or 'No verified rankings found for this domain's topics yet.' Live async run shows domain-loading card with copy 'Verifying against live Google results… Checking real citations and ranking positions.' Regressions (auth, remember-me, dashboard, visibility, citations, reddit, content optimizer text, superadmin entitlement) all still pass.

action_items: None required for iteration 4 scope. All Domain Analysis acceptance criteria met (Serper-verified sources, no hallucination, Claude in engines, verified topic-tied rankings, correct strict-mode empty states in UI).

Pre-existing (not in iter4 scope): the JS-heavy URL scraper still degrades to static-only fetch due to Playwright/browser version mismatch — see iteration_3.json 'rca of the issue'. Fix path: add PLAYWRIGHT_CHROME_EXECUTABLE_PATH=/usr/local/bin/browser-use-chromium to /app/backend/.env OR reinstall the matching chromium build.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:_run_domain_analysis is well-scoped: Step A brand-search citations, Step B LLM (Claude) grounded ONLY on real Serper snippets, Step C per-candidate live Google verification via _same_domain — clean 3-stage retrieval-first pipeline.

STRICT topic filter (server.py ~L630): 'candidate['topic'].lower() in topics_l OR any(pt in t or t in pt for t)' — same generous substring both-ways match as iter3. Works but a very short topic ('AI') could still match many prompts; consider tokenized/edit-distance for a stricter check. Not urgent — current behavior is safe with the extra Serper verification step.

_serper_sync timeout=15s and no retry. A single 5xx from google.serper.dev drops that query from citations/rankings without user-facing feedback; consider one bounded retry with exponential backoff for transient 429/5xx.

asyncio.gather(*[serper_search(...) for c in candidates]) fires 18-24 concurrent Serper calls per analysis (plus 4 brand queries). Serper's free tier is 100 req/day and paid tiers meter per-second — under sustained multi-user load this can rate-limit. Consider a small asyncio.Semaphore(8) around serper_search or asyncio.as_completed with per-request try/except (already handled via return_exceptions=True).

Result doc merges 'status':'done' with the whole result dict via a single $set — good. domain_get returns 404 only if the doc is missing; processing/error surface correctly to the UI. However: no server-side max age for 'processing' — a stuck job stays processing forever (same iter3 finding).

DomainAnalysis.js UI loading copy is now 'Verifying against live Google results…' — accurate to Serper reality. Also good that ranking-prompts empty state renders 'No verified rankings found for this domain's topics yet.' (a friendly correct-behavior message, not an error).
server.py is 877 lines; iter3 recommendation to split into routers/services still stands but not blocking.
SERPER_API_KEY is loaded from /app/backend/.env at import — no plaintext logs found in server logs. Good.
